# One-way fixed effects ANOVA power calculation
# Design: 3 groups, balanced, total N = 75 (25 per group)
# Effect size: eta-squared = 0.08
# Significance level: alpha = 0.05

# Parameters
k <- 3                    # number of groups
N <- 75                   # total sample size
n <- N / k                # sample size per group (25)
eta_sq <- 0.08           # population eta-squared
alpha <- 0.05            # significance level

# Noncentrality parameter for F-test
# Formula: λ = n * k * η² / (1 - η²)
# where n is per-group sample size and k is number of groups
lambda <- n * k * eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)

cat("Design parameters:\n")
cat("  Number of groups (k):", k, "\n")
cat("  Total sample size (N):", N, "\n")
cat("  Sample size per group (n):", n, "\n")
cat("  Population eta-squared:", eta_sq, "\n")
cat("  Significance level (alpha):", alpha, "\n\n")

cat("Degrees of freedom:\n")
df_numerator <- k - 1         # Between-group df
df_denominator <- N - k       # Within-group df
cat("  Numerator df (k - 1):", df_numerator, "\n")
cat("  Denominator df (N - k):", df_denominator, "\n\n")

cat("Noncentrality parameter:\n")
cat("  λ = n × k × η² / (1 - η²)\n")
cat("  λ = ", n, " × ", k, " × ", eta_sq, " / (1 - ", eta_sq, ")\n")
cat("  λ =", lambda, "\n\n")

# Critical F-value at alpha = 0.05 from central F distribution
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df_numerator, df_denominator)
cat("Critical F-value (central F):\n")
cat("  F_crit at alpha =", alpha, ":", F_crit, "\n\n")

# Power = P(F > F_crit | H1) using noncentral F distribution
# Power is the tail probability of the noncentral F distribution beyond F_crit
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df_numerator, df_denominator, ncp = lambda)

cat("Power calculation:\n")
cat("  Power = P(F > F_crit | λ) from noncentral F(", df_numerator, ", ", df_denominator, ", λ =", lambda, ")\n")
cat("  Power =", power, "\n\n")

# Summary
cat("RESULT:\n")
cat("Omnibus F-test power:", round(power, 6), "\n")

# Return result in required format
result <- data.frame(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\n")
print(result)

# JSON output
library(jsonlite)
json_output <- toJSON(list(results = list(list(metric = "power", value = power, unit = "probability"))), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", json_output, "\n", sep = "")

cat("  λ = n × k × η² / (1 - η²)\n")

# Detailed mathematical verification of noncentrality parameter formula
# for one-way fixed-effects ANOVA

cat("=== MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATION FOR NONCENTRALITY PARAMETER ===\n\n")

# Parameters
k <- 3
N <- 75
n <- N / k
eta_sq <- 0.08
alpha <- 0.05

cat("Relationship between eta-squared and noncentrality:\n\n")

# The relationship is derived from the model:
# Under H1, we have k group means that differ
# The effect size is quantified by eta-squared: η² = SS_between / SS_total
#
# In terms of noncentrality parameter λ for the F-distribution:
# Under the alternative hypothesis with k groups and N total observations:
# η² = λ / (λ + N)  [for balanced design, per-group n = N/k]
#
# Solving for λ:
# η² * (λ + N) = λ
# η² * λ + η² * N = λ
# η² * N = λ - η² * λ
# η² * N = λ(1 - η²)
# λ = η² * N / (1 - η²)

cat("Formula derivation:\n")
cat("  η² = λ / (λ + N)\n")
cat("  Solving for λ:\n")
cat("  η² * (λ + N) = λ\n")
cat("  η² * N = λ * (1 - η²)\n")
cat("  λ = η² * N / (1 - η²)\n\n")

lambda_formula1 <- (eta_sq * N) / (1 - eta_sq)
cat("Using formula λ = η² * N / (1 - η²):\n")
cat("  λ = ", eta_sq, "* ", N, " / (1 - ", eta_sq, ")\n")
cat("  λ = ", lambda_formula1, "\n\n")

# Alternative form for balanced design:
# λ = n * k * η² / (1 - η²)
# Both should be equivalent since N = n*k

lambda_formula2 <- (n * k * eta_sq) / (1 - eta_sq)
cat("Using formula λ = n * k * η² / (1 - η²) (balanced design):\n")
cat("  λ = ", n, "* ", k, "* ", eta_sq, " / (1 - ", eta_sq, ")\n")
cat("  λ = ", lambda_formula2, "\n")
cat("  (equivalent to previous):", isTRUE(all.equal(lambda_formula1, lambda_formula2)), "\n\n")

# Yet another equivalent form: λ = N * η² / (1 - η²)
# This is the most general form
lambda_general <- (N * eta_sq) / (1 - eta_sq)
cat("General form λ = N * η² / (1 - η²):\n")
cat("  λ = ", lambda_general, "\n\n")

cat("=== VERIFICATION: INVERSE RELATIONSHIP ===\n\n")

# Given λ, we can recover η²
eta_sq_recovered <- lambda_general / (lambda_general + N)
cat("Recovering η² from λ:\n")
cat("  η² = λ / (λ + N)\n")
cat("  η² = ", lambda_general, " / (", lambda_general, "+", N, ")\n")
cat("  η² = ", eta_sq_recovered, "\n")
cat("  Original η² =", eta_sq, "\n")
cat("  Match:", isTRUE(all.equal(eta_sq_recovered, eta_sq)), "\n\n")

# Degrees of freedom verification
df1 <- k - 1
df2 <- N - k

cat("=== DEGREES OF FREEDOM ===\n\n")
cat("Numerator DF (between groups): k - 1 =", k, "- 1 =", df1, "\n")
cat("Denominator DF (within groups): N - k =", N, "-", k, "=", df2, "\n")
cat("Total DF: N - 1 =", N, "- 1 =", N - 1, "\n")
cat("Check: DF1 + DF2 + 1 = k - 1 + N - k + 1 = N = ", df1 + df2 + 1, "\n\n")

# Power computation
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df1, df2)
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df1, df2, ncp = lambda_general)

cat("=== POWER COMPUTATION ===\n\n")
cat("Critical F-value at α =", alpha, "with df = (", df1, ",", df2, "):\n")
cat("  F_crit =", F_crit, "\n\n")
cat("Power = P(F > F_crit | λ =", lambda_general, ")\n")
cat("  = 1 - P(F ≤ F_crit | λ =", lambda_general, ")\n")
cat("  = 1 - pf(", F_crit, ",", df1, ",", df2, ", ncp =", lambda_general, ")\n")
cat("  =", power, "\n\n")

cat("=== FINAL ANSWER ===\n")
cat("Power =", format(power, digits = 15), "\n")

# JSON
library(jsonlite)
json_result <- toJSON(
  list(results = list(
    list(metric = "power", value = power, unit = "probability")
  )),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  digits = 15
)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", json_result, sep = "")

# Now, λ = n * Σ(μᵢ - μ)² / σ²
# Therefore: Σ(μᵢ - μ)² = λ * σ² / n

sum_sq_deviations <- lambda * sigma2 / n
cat("This implies: Σ(μᵢ - μ)² = λ * σ² / n =", sum_sq_deviations, "\n\n")

# For k group means with grand mean 0, if they're equally spaced:
# Simple case: place them symmetrically
# For k=3, place at -a, 0, a where 2*a² + 0² = sum_sq_deviations
# OR more generally: use rnorm with appropriate sd

sd_group_means_correct <- sqrt(sum_sq_deviations / k)
cat("Standard deviation for group means:\n")
cat("  σ_group = sqrt(Σ(μᵢ - μ)² / k) =", sd_group_means_correct, "\n\n")

# Simulation with correctly parametrized group means
cat("=== SIMULATION WITH CORRECT PARAMETRIZATION ===\n\n")

set.seed(12345)
n_sims <- 10000
rejections <- 0
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, k - 1, N - k)

# Fixed group means based on noncentrality
# Let's use a deterministic setup to verify
# Place group means at: -a, 0, a such that Σ(μᵢ - μ)² = sum_sq_deviations
# with grand mean = 0

a <- sqrt(sum_sq_deviations / 2)  # For 3 groups at -a, 0, a: sum is 2a²
group_means_fixed <- c(-a, 0, a)

cat("Fixed group means (for deterministic check):\n")
cat("  Group means:", group_means_fixed, "\n")
cat("  Grand mean:", mean(group_means_fixed), "\n")
cat("  Σ(μᵢ - μ)²:", sum((group_means_fixed - mean(group_means_fixed))^2), "\n")
cat("  Check (should be", sum_sq_deviations, "):", 
    abs(sum((group_means_fixed - mean(group_means_fixed))^2) - sum_sq_deviations) < 1e-10, "\n\n")

# Verify this gives η² = 0.08
# Theoretical: Under H1, population η² = 0.08
# Population: σ²_between = Σ(μᵢ - μ)² / k = sum_sq_deviations / k
# η² = σ²_between / (σ²_between + σ²_within)

sigma2_between_pop <- sum_sq_deviations / k
eta_sq_check <- sigma2_between_pop / (sigma2_between_pop + sigma2)
cat("Population effect size check:\n")
cat("  σ²_between =", sigma2_between_pop, "\n")
cat("  σ²_within =", sigma2, "\n")
cat("  η² =", eta_sq_check, "(should be 0.08)\n\n")

for (sim in 1:n_sims) {
  # Generate data for each group using fixed means
  data <- rep(NA, N)
  idx <- 1
  for (i in 1:k) {
    data[idx:(idx + n - 1)] <- rnorm(n, mean = group_means_fixed[i], sd = sqrt(sigma2))
    idx <- idx + n
  }
  
  # Create group indicator
  group <- rep(1:k, each = n)
  
  # Conduct ANOVA
  aov_result <- aov(data ~ factor(group))
  f_stat <- summary(aov_result)[[1]]$`F value`[1]
  
  # Check if F exceeds critical value
  if (f_stat > F_crit) {
    rejections <- rejections + 1
  }
}

power_sim <- rejections / n_sims
se_sim <- sqrt(power_sim * (1 - power_sim) / n_sims)
ci_sim <- power_sim + c(-1.96, 1.96) * se_sim

cat("Simulation with fixed group means:\n")
cat("  Rejections:", rejections, "out of", n_sims, "\n")
cat("  Simulated power:", power_sim, "\n")
cat("  Standard error:", se_sim, "\n")
cat("  95% CI: [", ci_sim[1], ",", ci_sim[2], "]\n\n")

# Analytical power
power_analytical <- 1 - pf(F_crit, k - 1, N - k, ncp = lambda)

cat("=== COMPARISON ===\n\n")
cat("Analytical power:    ", format(power_analytical, digits = 15), "\n")
cat("Simulation power:    ", format(power_sim, digits = 6), "\n")
cat("  95% CI: [", format(ci_sim[1], digits = 6), ",", format(ci_sim[2], digits = 6), "]\n")
cat("  Contains analytical:", power_analytical >= ci_sim[1] && power_analytical <= ci_sim[2], "\n\n")

if (power_analytical >= ci_sim[1] && power_analytical <= ci_sim[2]) {
  cat("✓ VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL: Simulation matches analytical result\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✗ MISMATCH: Simulation does not match analytical result\n")
  cat("  Difference:", abs(power_analytical - power_sim), "\n\n")
}

# JSON result
library(jsonlite)
json_result <- toJSON(
  list(results = list(
    list(metric = "power", value = power_analytical, unit = "probability")
  )),
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  digits = 15
)

# One-way fixed effects ANOVA power calculation
# Design: 3 groups, balanced, total N = 75 (25 per group)
# Effect size: eta-squared = 0.08
# Significance level: alpha = 0.05

# Parameters
k <- 3                    # number of groups
N <- 75                   # total sample size
n <- N / k                # sample size per group (25)
eta_sq <- 0.08           # population eta-squared
alpha <- 0.05            # significance level

# Noncentrality parameter for F-test
# Formula: λ = n * k * η² / (1 - η²)
# where n is per-group sample size and k is number of groups
lambda <- n * k * eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)

cat("Design parameters:\n")
cat("  Number of groups (k):", k, "\n")
cat("  Total sample size (N):", N, "\n")
cat("  Sample size per group (n):", n, "\n")
cat("  Population eta-squared:", eta_sq, "\n")
cat("  Significance level (alpha):", alpha, "\n\n")

cat("Degrees of freedom:\n")
df_numerator <- k - 1         # Between-group df
df_denominator <- N - k       # Within-group df
cat("  Numerator df (k - 1):", df_numerator, "\n")
cat("  Denominator df (N - k):", df_denominator, "\n\n")

cat("Noncentrality parameter:\n")
cat("  λ = n × k × η² / (1 - η²)\n")
cat("  λ = ", n, " × ", k, " × ", eta_sq, " / (1 - ", eta_sq, ")\n")
cat("  λ =", lambda, "\n\n")

# Critical F-value at alpha = 0.05 from central F distribution
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df_numerator, df_denominator)
cat("Critical F-value (central F):\n")
cat("  F_crit at alpha =", alpha, ":", F_crit, "\n\n")

# Power = P(F > F_crit | H1) using noncentral F distribution
# Power is the tail probability of the noncentral F distribution beyond F_crit
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df_numerator, df_denominator, ncp = lambda)

cat("Power calculation:\n")
cat("  Power = P(F > F_crit | λ) from noncentral F(", df_numerator, ", ", df_denominator, ", λ =", lambda, ")\n")
cat("  Power =", power, "\n\n")

# Summary
cat("RESULT:\n")
cat("Omnibus F-test power:", round(power, 6), "\n")

# Return result in required format
result <- data.frame(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\n")
print(result)

# JSON output
library(jsonlite)
json_output <- toJSON(list(results = list(list(metric = "power", value = power, unit = "probability"))), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", json_output, "\n", sep = "")

# for one-way fixed-effects ANOVA

cat("=== MATHEMATICAL FOUNDATION FOR NONCENTRALITY PARAMETER ===\n\n")

# Parameters
k <- 3
N <- 75
n <- N / k
eta_sq <- 0.08
alpha <- 0.05

cat("Relationship between eta-squared and noncentrality:\n\n")

# The relationship is derived from the model:
# Under H1, we have k group means that differ
# The effect size is quantified by eta-squared: η² = SS_between / SS_total
#
# In terms of noncentrality parameter λ for the F-distribution:
# Under the alternative hypothesis with k groups and N total observations:
# η² = λ / (λ + N)  [for balanced design, per-group n = N/k]
#
# Solving for λ:
# η² * (λ + N) = λ
# η² * λ + η² * N = λ
# η² * N = λ - η² * λ
# η² * N = λ(1 - η²)
# λ = η² * N / (1 - η²)

cat("Formula derivation:\n")
cat("  η² = λ / (λ + N)\n")
cat("  Solving for λ:\n")
cat("  η² * (λ + N) = λ\n")
cat("  η² * N = λ * (1 - η²)\n")
cat("  λ = η² * N / (1 - η²)\n\n")

lambda_formula1 <- (eta_sq * N) / (1 - eta_sq)
cat("Using formula λ = η² * N / (1 - η²):\n")
cat("  λ = ", eta_sq, "* ", N, " / (1 - ", eta_sq, ")\n")
cat("  λ = ", lambda_formula1, "\n\n")

# Alternative form for balanced design:
# λ = n * k * η² / (1 - η²)
# Both should be equivalent since N = n*k

lambda_formula2 <- (n * k * eta_sq) / (1 - eta_sq)
cat("Using formula λ = n * k * η² / (1 - η²) (balanced design):\n")
cat("  λ = ", n, "* ", k, "* ", eta_sq, " / (1 - ", eta_sq, ")\n")
cat("  λ = ", lambda_formula2, "\n")
cat("  (equivalent to previous):", isTRUE(all.equal(lambda_formula1, lambda_formula2)), "\n\n")

# Yet another equivalent form: λ = N * η² / (1 - η²)
# This is the most general form
lambda_general <- (N * eta_sq) / (1 - eta_sq)
cat("General form λ = N * η² / (1 - η²):\n")
cat("  λ = ", lambda_general, "\n\n")

cat("=== VERIFICATION: INVERSE RELATIONSHIP ===\n\n")

# Given λ, we can recover η²
eta_sq_recovered <- lambda_general / (lambda_general + N)
cat("Recovering η² from λ:\n")
cat("  η² = λ / (λ + N)\n")
cat("  η² = ", lambda_general, " / (", lambda_general, "+", N, ")\n")

# Evidence e1; success=true

# One-way fixed effects ANOVA power calculation
# Design: 3 groups, balanced, total N = 75 (25 per group)
# Effect size: eta-squared = 0.08
# Significance level: alpha = 0.05

# Parameters
k <- 3                    # number of groups
N <- 75                   # total sample size
n <- N / k                # sample size per group (25)
eta_sq <- 0.08           # population eta-squared
alpha <- 0.05            # significance level

# Noncentrality parameter for F-test
# Formula: λ = n * k * η² / (1 - η²)
# where n is per-group sample size and k is number of groups
lambda <- n * k * eta_sq / (1 - eta_sq)

cat("Design parameters:\n")
cat("  Number of groups (k):", k, "\n")
cat("  Total sample size (N):", N, "\n")
cat("  Sample size per group (n):", n, "\n")
cat("  Population eta-squared:", eta_sq, "\n")
cat("  Significance level (alpha):", alpha, "\n\n")

cat("Degrees of freedom:\n")
df_numerator <- k - 1         # Between-group df
df_denominator <- N - k       # Within-group df
cat("  Numerator df (k - 1):", df_numerator, "\n")
cat("  Denominator df (N - k):", df_denominator, "\n\n")

cat("Noncentrality parameter:\n")
cat("  λ = n × k × η² / (1 - η²)\n")
cat("  λ = ", n, " × ", k, " × ", eta_sq, " / (1 - ", eta_sq, ")\n")
cat("  λ =", lambda, "\n\n")

# Critical F-value at alpha = 0.05 from central F distribution
F_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df_numerator, df_denominator)
cat("Critical F-value (central F):\n")
cat("  F_crit at alpha =", alpha, ":", F_crit, "\n\n")

# Power = P(F > F_crit | H1) using noncentral F distribution
# Power is the tail probability of the noncentral F distribution beyond F_crit
power <- 1 - pf(F_crit, df_numerator, df_denominator, ncp = lambda)

cat("Power calculation:\n")
cat("  Power = P(F > F_crit | λ) from noncentral F(", df_numerator, ", ", df_denominator, ", λ =", lambda, ")\n")
cat("  Power =", power, "\n\n")

# Summary
cat("RESULT:\n")
cat("Omnibus F-test power:", round(power, 6), "\n")

# Return result in required format
result <- data.frame(
  metric = "power",
  value = power,
  unit = "probability"
)

cat("\n")
print(result)

# JSON output
library(jsonlite)
json_output <- toJSON(list(results = list(list(metric = "power", value = power, unit = "probability"))), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", json_output, "\n", sep = "")
